instruction: A plain pine coffee table: a rectangular top with lightly rounded edges and believable board thickness, a simple apron under the top, and four straight square legs. Light natural pine, game-ready simplicity.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a pine coffee table. A plain pine coffee table: a rectangular top with lightly rounded edges and believable board thickness, a simple apron under the top, and four straight square legs. Light natural pine, game-ready simplicity. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
